Dear [Miss Gordon Cumming](/person/571)
I had an intimation from the [publisher](/person/1344) that he is going to change printers, and so that I must finish up all there is in type before August. This is keeping you, as well as many other papers back, but I hope to be able to get them in then.[^1]
Something unexpected always happens when one hopes one has comfortable space Miss Sewell’s letters went on two numbers more than I reckoned on.
I have just got Granite Crags

yours truly

C M Yonge


[^1]: The existing printer was [Clay](/organisation/173), the new one [Clowes](/organisation/245). The article referred to here as awaiting publication was perhaps \'Cawnpore and Lucknow\' MP (October 1884), 358-376.
